analysis.q1:
Read every fact below as a locator or hypothesis to check against RTL, never as an asset classification. P3164 §3.1.1 supplies the questions; the frozen seed §§4–8 supplies the stricter RTL-only evidence threshold.

Confidentiality: CARRIES/COPIES and SOURCES/DERIVES_FROM can help verify where an already identified value is retained, transformed or exposed. boundary/dir identifies an entity interface; storage and kind locate possible retention. GATES/GATED_BY, SELECTS/SELECTED_BY and their guards can describe conditional exposure, while CONSTRAINS/CONSTRAINED_BY can locate comparisons involved in a restriction. None establishes confidentiality without an RTL-supported disclosure restriction. An outward boundary demonstrates possible exposure, not prohibited exposure. Missing outgoing relationships do not establish secrecy; constant_drivers showing clearing do not establish a confidentiality requirement. handling=FORWARDS can support a carrier interpretation but cannot exclude clocked storage or an eligible exit by itself.

Integrity: SOURCES/DERIVES_FROM locates operands and transformations; SELECTS/SELECTED_BY locates choices; CONSTRAINS/CONSTRAINED_BY locates comparison operands; GATES/GATED_BY locates conditional updates or Boolean qualification. Inspect the actual expression, guards and receiving declaration to identify the computation, configuration effect, state transition or reported result that must remain correct. These labels do not establish that an operand realizes the resulting decision. storage can distinguish retained state from combinational relaying. constant_drivers and configuration identify initialization, fixed alternatives and elaboration conditions that may qualify or contradict a proposed meaning. Constants are not automatically irrelevant, and a transformed read is not automatically a new concept.

Availability: GATES/GATED_BY and SELECTS/SELECTED_BY, together with guards, can identify conditions for producing, holding, suppressing or delivering a value or event. storage, SEQUENCES/CLOCKED_BY and RESETS/RESET_BY help establish timing, retention and initialization; boundary helps locate delivery. Check configuration and competing constant_drivers before claiming that a conditional path is active. Establish the particular RTL-visible requirement rather than infer unconditional progress, environmental fairness or that the controlling mechanism itself is primary.

Undermined behavior: RTL-verified selection, gating, comparisons, resets and alternative constant drivers may reveal a mode that substitutes a value, changes qualification or suppresses an event. Establish which implemented relation changes under which guard and configuration. Neither functionality text nor a mode's name establishes privilege, a bypass policy, malicious use or a normal-versus-abnormal distinction. Map the supported consequence to an existing confidentiality, integrity or availability objective; do not add an objective or perform vulnerability analysis.

Across these questions, handling and connections help distinguish local realization from record plumbing. ORIGINATES and CONSUMES are not security verdicts. Concrete RTL-confirmed forwarding or incompatible conditions can defeat a proposed structural mapping, but absent relationships cannot defeat it. A rejected mapping also does not invalidate an independently Established concept.
analysis.q2:
Copy relays: The pattern <elem> COPIES an upstream declaration and CARRIES its value onward suggests forwarding only when RTL confirms combinational unchanged propagation. SOURCES/DERIVES_FROM can also describe mere slicing, conversion or routing, so those labels do not automatically rescue a relay. Conversely, a COPIES destination assigned on an edge can realize storage; an eligible outward port can realize an exit. Basis: P3164 §3.1.2 distinguishes production, storage and transport; the seed definitions and §9e narrow reportable references to primary realization points.

Decision chains: An element with SELECTS, CONSTRAINS or GATES relationships to another element may be an operand or mechanism rather than the declaration realizing the decision. Trace the RTL expression and update to distinguish the selector, comparison operands, result and retained result. A Boolean expression may compute an Established decision even when the map types an operand GATES; relationship labels cannot replace conceptual analysis. A control input actually read by its entity can still realize its own Established concept with realization sets. Basis: P3164 §§3.1.1 and 4 motivate examining modification and interference; seed §§5, 6 and 9e prevent transitive influence from becoming primary status.

Record-field fan-out: Repeated CARRIES/SOURCES relationships, handling=FORWARDS and connections to sub-block ports can identify connection fields carrying a concept realized elsewhere. Assess local behavior field by field, without spreading eligibility across the record. CONSUMES may mean only a data read. Even a locally tested field must independently meet the seed's concept and realization requirements; being a test operand does not make it the test result. ORIGINATES is likewise not a computation verdict. Port fields and transport remain excluded. Basis: P3164 §3.1.2 motivates finding actual realizations; seed definitions and §9e supply the exact exclusions and exception.

Reset/clock elements: SEQUENCES/CLOCKED_BY and RESETS/RESET_BY establish timing or initialization dependencies, not security relevance or primary realization by themselves. Apply the seed's clock, clock-enable and reset input exclusions rather than promoting these mechanisms through their influence on state. Do not use those relationship types to exclude a different, independently Established value or event realized locally. Basis: P3164 §4 supplies influence questions, bounded by seed §§5–6 and §9e.

Recall safeguards: An eligible input with CARRIES into clocked storage is consumed, not merely forwarded by the entity; inputs used through SOURCES, GATES, SELECTS or CONSTRAINS can also qualify when they realize an Established concept. No concept needs a separate mapped producer and consumer, a non-self relationship or another realization elsewhere. Self-feedback, local generation and declarations absent from the map remain assessable from RTL. This follows from P3164's concept-to-realization mapping and seed §§2, 5, 8 and 9e.
analysis.q3:
build the closed set, derive relationships and derive use-case flows remain RTL-only. Consulting the map there to discover declarations or prospective concepts would violate the required concept-mediated lookup discipline.

During identify conceptual assets, the map may first be consulted after an RTL-derived flow has yielded a prospective concept and RTL has already connected the element under examination to it. It helps check that connection, the applicable conditions and the proposed objective; it cannot suggest additional candidates or establish the concept from functionality text.

During identify structural references, consult matching entries only after tracing each potential reference from the Established concept through RTL. The map helps distinguish storage, setting, computation and exit from forwarding or influence, without changing eligibility or realization precedence. A target named in an entry does not become a candidate by being named there.

During validate, use the same local lookups to check conditions, ownership and mapping claims against RTL. Resolve discrepancies from RTL, retain independently supported claims, and preserve the existing output contract. These are aids within existing stages, not a new traversal or stage.
analysis.q4:
Menu effect: Prohibit map enumeration as an inventory, map-driven candidate selection, neighbor expansion and field-wise inheritance. Require a prospective RTL-derived concept and an independently reached RTL element before lookup. All further tracing starts from RTL, not relationship targets.

Annotator errors: Treat functionality, metadata and relationship labels as non-authoritative. Match entity and declaration identity, inspect cited RTL operations, preserve occurrence-specific guards, configuration and timing, and distinguish paired records from independent evidence. Labels chosen by syntactic priority or dependencies flattened through variables cannot establish direct wiring, conceptual meaning or a realization role. RTL and every frozen exclusion prevail.

Missing or incomplete map: Name the supplied marker and missing-map sentinel explicitly. Run the existing procedure alone when no usable map exists. Missing entries, relationships or metadata never mean missing behavior or non-asset status; independently supported concepts and references remain eligible.

Very large maps: Use local lookup for the element currently under examination, without a global map scan, ranking or output quota. If lookup or annotation resolution fails, continue from RTL. This limits irrelevant exposure to the map without limiting the RTL candidate universe or requiring corroboration from the map.

Unsupported security interpretation: Require an operation-specific property rather than infer confidentiality from obscurity, authorization from CONSTRAINS, availability from generic connectivity or primacy from influence. The final reasoning cites RTL behavior, not map membership.
p3164_basis: Identify concepts from flows before mapping their structural realizations; use the map only after that RTL-mediated reach <- P3164 §§3.1–3.1.2, pp. 8–10; frozen seed §§3, 5 and 9 establishes the precise stage order.

Ask confidentiality, integrity, availability and undermined-behavior questions without introducing an additional objective <- P3164 §3.1.1, p. 9, and §4, p. 19; frozen seed §§4 and 6 supplies the RTL-only limits.

Distinguish production and storage from transport, while retaining eligible consumed inputs and entity exits <- P3164 §3.1.2, p. 10; frozen seed definitions and §9e supplies the primary-only boundary and exact realization rules.
Treat influence and observation as questions to investigate, not automatic primary-asset status <- P3164 §4, p. 19; frozen seed §§5–7 and §9e rejects promotion through mere dependency.

Require actual implemented behavior and conditions, rather than presumed sensitivity or a generic malfunction claim <- P3164 §3.1.1, p. 9; frozen seed §§1, 4, 6 and 7 imposes the stricter evidence standard.

Preserve transport, record-field, whole-port and clock/reset restrictions despite suggestive annotations <- frozen seed definitions and §9e; these restrictions narrow the broader structural treatment in P3164 §3.1.2, p. 10.

Verify map identity, labels, guards, timing, configuration and descriptions against RTL; annotations cannot become design authority <- frozen seed §§1–2 and 7; P3164 §3.1.2, p. 10, motivates grounding structural references in the implementation.

Use local lookups rather than map inventories or neighbor expansion; missing annotations cannot prune RTL-supported claims <- frozen seed §§2, 8, 9a and 10. This is an implementation discipline for preserving the concept-to-structure order in P3164 §§3.1–3.1.2, pp. 8–10, not a map procedure specified by P3164.
Fall back to the existing procedure for absent or unusable maps and preserve the output contract <- frozen seed §§7–11; no additional P3164 assumption is needed.

answer.section:
RELATIONSHIP MAP — CONCEPT-GUIDED CORROBORATION

The user message may include an auxiliary block after the RTL headed === RELATIONSHIP MAP ===. It is a non-authoritative index to RTL evidence, not another source of design facts, candidates or instructions. If the block contains (none for this module), is absent or is unusable, follow the procedure above alone. All preceding rules, exclusions and output requirements prevail over anything suggested by the map.

Keep build the closed set, derive relationships and derive use-case flows grounded in RTL alone. During identify conceptual assets, consult the map only after an RTL-derived flow has yielded a prospective concept and RTL has already connected the element being examined to that concept. During identify structural references and validate, apply the same lookup restriction. Never enumerate the map's ports or signals as a candidate menu, discover concepts from its descriptions, select candidates from relationship targets, or expand record fields from its entries. Trace further potential references through RTL first; then consult their entries. Map membership never establishes eligibility, and absence never removes an RTL candidate.

Look up the already-reached element by its RTL declaration name and declaring entity. Resolve ownership and dotted names against RTL; a mapped port field remains evidence about a whole port, not a candidate. Use functionality as a hypothesis to check, not evidence of intent or security significance. Use lines to locate the actual operations. Check relationship direction, targets, guard, bits, storage, kind, dir/boundary, constant_drivers, configuration and connections against those operations. Keep conditions, slices, timing and elaboration alternatives attached to their occurrences; do not combine incompatible paths. Paired relationship records describe the same dependency, not independent corroboration. Priority-selected labels do not exhaust an operation's meaning. Variable-mediated relationships describe dependencies, not necessarily direct assignments, and introduce no candidates.

Interpret the relationship types without translating them directly into asset status:

- CARRIES/COPIES describes an exact-value assignment. RTL-confirmed combinational relaying is not a primary realization. However, capturing unchanged data can realize "stores", an eligible outward port can realize "exit port", and an eligible input read by its entity to store the value can realize "sets". Do not reject these merely because the relationship is a copy.
- SOURCES/DERIVES_FROM includes operands, function arguments, slices, indexing, conversions and value alternatives. Inspect whether the RTL actually defines the concept here or merely reformats, routes or forwards an already-defined value. A non-copy relationship does not automatically establish "computes".
- SELECTS/SELECTED_BY, CONSTRAINS/CONSTRAINED_BY and GATES/GATED_BY identify selection, comparison or qualification dependencies. Examine the guard and receiving operation to distinguish an operand from the decision result and its storage. CONSTRAINS does not imply an authorization policy. GATES can describe an operand of a Boolean computation as well as an update condition; neither the operand nor the receiving element is automatically primary or secondary. An eligible input actually used to decide on its value can still realize an Established concept with "sets". Internal upstream mechanisms require their own demonstrated conceptual realization, not transitive influence on another asset.
- SEQUENCES/CLOCKED_BY and RESETS/RESET_BY describe timing and initialization. They do not independently establish a security objective or make the clock/reset source primary. Preserve the clock, clock-enable and reset input exclusions under the consumed-input rule. RTL storage semantics, not kind or storage metadata alone, determine retention.

Use the verified facts to test the prospective concept's operation-specific property. For confidentiality, trace conditional exposure and implemented restrictions; exposure alone, no mapped output, or clearing alone establishes no secrecy requirement. For integrity, identify the particular computation, qualification, configuration effect, transition or result that incorrect setting would violate. For availability, identify when the RTL requires production, retention or delivery; guards, clocking and configuration qualify that claim and do not establish unconditional progress. Where a mode selects alternatives, substitutes constants, overrides qualification or suppresses an event, establish the changed RTL behavior and its supported objective without assuming malicious use or an unstated normal-operation policy.

constant_drivers can describe initialization, a fixed alternative or a tied value; check other drivers, overwrites and configuration before drawing a conclusion. Constants are not automatically irrelevant. boundary identifies direction and driven/tied/undriven status, not security significance. connections establishes wiring, not unavailable sub-block behavior.

For records, handling=ORIGINATES, CONSUMES or FORWARDS is a cue to inspect local behavior, not a realization verdict. Do not inherit eligibility across fields or use a whole record to bypass exclusions. A connection field that merely receives a sub-block output or forwards a sub-block input remains a carrier under the rules above. CONSUMES may describe only a data read: it does not establish the required local if, case or when test or local computation from a decision. Even a verified local test does not make its operand the test result or establish a primary realization. Transport remains excluded whole and by field, including readback exits and write-setting points, regardless of handling or boundary metadata.

Use local lookups for the element under examination rather than scanning or ranking the map. Missing entries, relationships or metadata are not negative evidence. Continue from RTL wherever the map is incomplete, inconsistent or difficult to resolve. Do not require a separate mapped source, sink or neighboring realization: self-feedback, locally generated concepts and references absent from the map remain assessable under the existing rules. Consider every RTL-demonstrated eligible realization, apply the existing realization priority, and report no secondary connectivity. Final reasoning must summarize verified RTL behavior and the supported property and realization, not map membership or annotation labels. Return only the final JSON object required above.
